registry_date_HE: 12026年7月19日（人类纪元；对应公元2026年7月19日）
purpose: Canonical jurisdiction-level copyright rule registry for Q33 global copyright risk projection and external input rights governance. All rules sourced exclusively from official legislative databases, WIPO Lex, EUR-Lex, and GitHub official policy pages.
rule_authority_principle: Only official, original, current-source rules are authoritative. Blogs, search summaries, old lab content, and model memory are NOT rule authority.
fallback_principle: When rule currentness cannot be confirmed, official source is inaccessible, jurisdiction conflicts exist, or facts are insufficient: register as UNVERIFIED, COUNSEL_REQUIRED, PERMISSION_REQUIRED, INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION, or BLOCKED_PENDING_EVIDENCE.

Berne_Convention_1886.title: Berne Convention for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works (Stockholm Act 1967)
key_principles: Minimum term: life of author + 50 years (Art. 7)
Berne_Convention_1886.notes: Universal baseline; all surveyed jurisdictions are signatories.

WCT_1996.title: WIPO Copyright Treaty (1996) — digital environment special agreement under Berne
key_principles: Computer programs protected as literary works (Art. 4)
Rights of reproduction, distribution, rental, communication to the public (Art. 6-8)

TRIPS_Copyright.title: Agreement on Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights — Part II: Copyright and Related Rights
key_principles: Berne Articles 1-21 apply via TRIPS Art. 9(1)
Protection extends to expressions not ideas/procedures/methods (Art. 9(2))
Three-step test codified: limited exceptions, no conflict with normal exploitation, no unreasonable prejudice to legitimate interests

US.name: United States
US.statute: 17 U.S.C. (Copyright Law of the United States)
US.copyright_office: U.S. Copyright Office / Library of Congress
US.contract_override: FAIR_USE_NOT_WAIVABLE_BY_CONTRACT (case law; fair use is a user right, not waivable)

EU.name: European Union (DSM Directive 2019/790)
EU.directive: Directive (EU) 2019/790 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 17 April 2019

Article_3.contract_override: Any contractual provision contrary to Article 3 shall be unenforceable

Article_4.contract_override: Right holders may reserve reproduction rights explicitly

Article_5.topic: Exceptions for acts by cultural heritage institutions and educational establishments
Article_5.contract_override: Any contractual provision contrary to Article 5 shall be unenforceable

Article_6.topic: Exceptions for text and data mining by research organisations and cultural heritage institutions

EU.implementation_note: Directive must be transposed into national law by each Member State; exceptions vary by jurisdiction within EU

UK.name: United Kingdom

exceptions.Section_30: Criticism, review, and quotation (fair dealing); news reporting
exceptions.Section_33: Extraction of short excerpts from newspapers

UK.post_brexit: CDPA 1988 remains UK law; DSM Directive no longer applies directly but UK maintains similar exceptions

CA.name: Canada

exceptions.Section_29: Research, private study, education, criticism, review, quotation

CA.user_rights_principle: Fair dealing is a user right, not merely an exception; broad interpretation required

exceptions.fair_dealing: research, private study, criticism, review, reporting current events
exceptions.note: Replaced Copyright Act 2021; fair dealing framework retained with updates

fair_dealing.latest_amendment: Amended up to Act No. 18 of 2023

GitHub_DMCA_Takedown_Policy.title: GitHub DMCA Takedown Policy
key_rules: DMCA requires a valid takedown notice with specific elements: identification of copyrighted work, identification of infringing material, contact info, good faith belief statement, accuracy under penalty of perjury, signature
Counter-notification rights: alleged infringer may submit counter-notification with consent to jurisdiction
Restoration after 10-14 business days if no lawsuit filed
Repository may be disabled after multiple violations

GitHub_DMCA_Guide.title: Guide to Submitting a DMCA Takedown Notice
key_rules: Notice must include all elements specified in 17 U.S.C. § 512(c)(3)

GitHub_dmca_repository.title: github/dmca — Repository with text of DMCA takedown notices as received
GitHub_dmca_repository.note: GitHub publishes received takedown notices publicly; does not endorse assertions in notices

contract_override_notable.EU_Art3_unenforceable: Contractual provisions contrary to Article 3 TDM exception are unenforceable
contract_override_notable.EU_Art5_unenforceable: Contractual provisions contrary to Article 5 exceptions are unenforceable
contract_override_notable.US_fair_use_non_waivable: Fair use is a user right, not waivable by contract (case law)
